# `r cv_section_icon("code")` Research Software

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

software <- data.frame(
  Name = c("pfwim.R", "SpatialBoundaries.jl", "FoodWebTools.jl", "Extinctions.jl"),
  Language = c("CRAN v1.0.2", "v0.2.0", "v0.1beta", "v0.1beta"),
  Description = c(
    "Paleo food web inference model",
    "Edge detection using spatial wombling",
    "Tools for building and measuring networks",
    "Extinction simulations of food webs"
  ),
  DOI = c("R", "Julia", "Julia", "Julia"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cv_entries(software, with = "Name", when = "Language",
           what = "Description", where = "DOI")
```
